features.summary: Entry point and minimum-terminal-size contract. 19 unit tests.
BootManager async health-check polling at 250ms, ≤5s timeout, Loading→Error→Ready transitions. 29 unit tests.
Three-lane layout at 80x24, 120x40, 60x20. No overlap/orphans/cursor-in-content. Selection survives resize. 17 tests.
AgentInventoryItem with 6 fields, deterministic sort (role asc, ID asc), CTA empty state. 21 tests.
focusedLane state with Tab/Shift+Tab cycling, DetailPane integration. 12 unit tests.
POST /api/agents/{id}/ask-stream on submit, progressive token rendering, goroutine cleanup, double-submit rejection.
Ctrl+X cancel, CancelAsk endpoint, per-stream context cancellation, '⊘ cancelled' state, rapid resubmit within 100ms. 5 tests.
'e' key opens drawer, ESC closes, 3 row types (text/tool/error), ≤200ms latency. 13 tests.
Single SSE subscription, debounced re-fetch (2s), reconnect on drop, proper cleanup. 15 tests.
StatusFooter component at bottom of cockpit with correct content in all phases. 17 tests.
Resize 120x40→80x24→120x40 during streaming preserves tokens, focus, cancel key. 6 tests + tuistory snapshots.
Malformed SSE detection and 💔 indicator rendering. 7 tests.
BootDaemon exported, temp storage root, lsof port discovery, deterministic agent seeding, sync.Once cleanup. 18 tests.
Retrospective with 10 findings, marketing string cleanup, Staticcheck QF1003 fix, go.mod pin correct. TUI tests pass. Lint clean.
